caption_draft: Register and force under both denominators. Each cell is its own pre-specified difference divided by its own paired within-prompt placebo's 95th percentile, so all four cells are in one unit and the grey strip is that placebo bar. Filled markers are the cells whose prompt-clustered interval excludes zero, which is the pre-registered decision rule; the two halves of the bar do not always agree, and the figure shows where. On the pre-registered rulers (left) register separates in 16 of 16 models, all downward, and the force total in 10, downward in 8. On the swapped rulers (right) the counts reverse: register 12 and force 14, all fourteen of the latter downward. The contrast between the two layers is therefore a property of the denominators as much as of the layers, which is why we report no magnitude ratio between them; what does not move with the ruler is the sign of the register fall.
